newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Libyan prime minister visits Morocco to boost ties.
newsitem.headline: Libyan prime minister visits Morocco to boost ties.

text.p: Libyan Prime Minister Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud has begun a visit to Morocco aimed at strengthening relations between the two North African countries, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Saturday.

Gu'ud, secretary of Libya's General Popular Committee, would meet Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali later on Saturday. Talks will cover preparations for the next meeting in Tripoli of the Moroccan-Libyan joint committee and how to reinforce economic relations.
Gu'ud carried greetings to King Hassan from Libyan leader Colonel Muammar Gaddafi, the agency said.

Libya last November sent its Secretary of Unity Affairs Jomaa el-Fezzani to Morocco, Tunisia and Algeria, after the announcement by France, Italy, Spain and Portugal that they were setting up a rapid intervention force to ensure peace and stability in the area.
The force was strongly criticised by Gaddafi.
